area: Voyages party play (VoyageRun, ArkEscortRun, VoyageCourseLink), Ark, ArkwayRun, cell fauna network gates
summary: Party voyages made one voyage across machines (Docs/Voyages/PARTY.md): host seeds and places every friend's corridor, syncs its Ark pose (Ark.FollowPose, ArkwayRun.HomeOverride/EndsOnArkFall), sends seats and the Crystal Run count; Escort the Ark now sends a course (ported by hand from your claude/voyage-coop) with shared fate; satellite cells never network-spawn fauna and pacify on every peer. Protocol 32. Not tested on two machines.
